morphological_rules: Initial vowel of base undergoes Vṛddhi (तद्धितेष्वचामादेः 7.2.117): v->vā, m->mā, r->rā, śi->śai.
Final u/ū takes Guṇa 'o' and then 'av' replacement before vowel affix (ओर्गुणः 6.4.146).
Final a is elided before vowel affix (यस्येति च 6.4.148).

'ओरौण् 6.4.146' is not a sūtra; 6.4.146 is ओर्गुणः
